marginal_concentration.note: N_eff = 1/sum p_c^2 of the measured class frequency vector over 2000 independent guarded walks at the pre-capture arm (S/sqrt(N)=0.71 at 20 steps against production 0.282).  Production is MORE pre-capture than this arm.
